title: Content & Script Writer- SkinCare
description:
Job Description: Content & Script Writer

**Company:** Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** SAEMORA  
**Location:** JP Nagar, 8th Phase, Bangalore  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Email:** skintheta@gmail.com  
**Phone:** +91 7996301234

About Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd.

Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd. is a next-generation skincare company driven by innovation, research, and design excellence. Rooted in advanced cosmetic science and inspired by global beauty standards, we create high-performance skincare solutions that combine functionality with refined aesthetics.

Our brand philosophy is built on precision, minimalism, and elevated design, bringing together science, creativity, and technology to deliver a premium skincare experience.

Through our brand SAEMORA, we aim to make skincare more informed, engaging, and accessible through thoughtful products and compelling brand communication.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, curious, and detail-oriented **Content & Script Writer** who can transform ideas, product benefits, skincare science, and consumer insights into compelling content and engaging video scripts.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of storytelling, audience psychology, digital content formats, and current social media trends. You should be able to develop creative concepts, write attention-grabbing hooks, build engaging narratives, and simplify skincare-related information into clear, credible, and relatable communication.

This role will primarily focus on writing scripts for Instagram Reels, short-form videos, educational content, product explainers, influencer collaborations, brand campaigns, and other digital formats.

We are looking for someone who can balance creativity with research, understand what captures audience attention, and develop content that strengthens brand awareness, builds consumer trust, and drives engagement.

Key Responsibilities1. Script Writing for Short-Form Videos

* Write engaging scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form video platforms.
* Develop compelling hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.
* Create scripts with clear storytelling, strong narrative flow, and effective calls to action.
* Write scripts in different formats, including educational, conversational, entertaining, problem-solution, myth-busting, and product-focused videos.
* Develop multiple script variations to test different hooks, angles, messaging styles, and storytelling approaches.
* Structure scripts with appropriate dialogue, voiceovers, visual cues, on-screen text, and scene transitions.
* Adapt scripts to different video durations and audience attention spans.
* Collaborate with the production team to ensure scripts translate effectively into engaging visual content.

2. Skincare Research & Educational Content

* Research skincare ingredients, formulations, routines, skin concerns, and emerging beauty trends.
* Translate complex skincare science into simple, engaging, and consumer-friendly language.
* Develop educational scripts on ingredients, product usage, skincare routines, common misconceptions, and frequently asked consumer questions.
* Research topics such as skin hydration, skin barrier care, sunscreen, exfoliation, acne-prone skin, pigmentation, and other relevant skincare subjects.
* Ensure content is factually accurate, credible, and aligned with approved product information.
* Verify claims using reliable sources and coordinate with the relevant internal team when technical clarification is required.
* Avoid exaggerated, misleading, or medically unsupported skincare claims.

3. Product Content & Brand Storytelling

* Develop scripts that communicate product features, key ingredients, benefits, usage instructions, and differentiating factors.
* Translate product specifications into meaningful consumer benefits.
* Create compelling product introduction videos, explainers, demonstrations, and launch content.
* Develop narratives that communicate the brand's philosophy, product development approach, quality standards, and design principles.
* Create content that builds consumer trust while maintaining a premium, science-led brand voice.
* Ensure consistent messaging across product pages, video scripts, campaign materials, and other consumer-facing content.

4. Creative Concept Development

* Brainstorm original content ideas for Reels, Shorts, product videos, and digital campaigns.
* Develop creative concepts based on audience questions, consumer pain points, skincare trends, and product positioning.
* Identify relatable situations, storytelling angles, and creative formats that make skincare content more engaging.
* Develop recurring content series and distinctive storytelling formats for the brand.
* Convert trending topics into relevant, brand-appropriate content ideas without blindly following every trend.
* Create content around skincare myths, common mistakes, routines, ingredient education, frequently asked questions, and consumer experiences.
* Prepare creative briefs and content outlines for shoots and campaigns.

5. Research, Trends & Audience Insights

* Monitor social media trends, emerging content formats, creator styles, and developments in the beauty and skincare industry.
* Research competitor content to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger storytelling.
* Study audience comments, questions, reviews, and feedback to discover relevant content topics.
* Analyse successful content formats and identify the storytelling elements that may have contributed to their performance.
* Maintain a structured repository of content ideas, references, hooks, scripts, and creative inspiration.
* Continuously explore new approaches to improve content relevance, originality, and audience retention.

6. Influencer & Creator Script Writing

* Develop briefs and scripts for influencers, content creators, and brand collaborators.
* Create clear talking points that communicate product benefits while allowing creators to maintain their natural style.
* Adapt scripts to different creator personalities, audiences, and content formats.
* Develop concepts for product demonstrations, testimonials, unboxing videos, routines, and educational collaborations.
* Ensure that creator content remains aligned with brand guidelines, approved claims, and campaign objectives.

7. Campaign & Marketing Copywriting

* Write headlines, captions, taglines, hooks, calls to action, and short-form promotional copy.
* Contribute creative ideas and messaging for product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand-building initiatives.
* Develop copy for advertisements, landing pages, product descriptions, and promotional materials when required.
* Adapt messaging for organic social media, paid campaigns, website content, and other digital channels.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, messaging, terminology, and communication standards.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure content supports campaign objectives.

8. Script Development & Production Coordination

* Prepare structured scripts with scene-by-scene breakdowns, dialogue, voiceovers, visual references, and on-screen text.
* Develop shot suggestions and visual storytelling cues to help production teams execute the concept.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions, shoot planning, and creative reviews.
* Work closely with videographers, editors, designers, marketers, and on-camera talent.
* Review edited videos to ensure that the final content communicates the intended message accurately.
* Incorporate feedback and revise scripts based on creative direction, production requirements, and campaign needs.
* Maintain an organised record of script versions, approvals, and content deliverables.

RequirementsExperience & Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in content writing, script writing, copywriting, digital content creation, or a related field.
* A portfolio demonstrating original writing, short-form video scripts, storytelling, or digital campaign content.
* Experience writing scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar video formats is preferred.
* Experience in skincare, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, D2C, or e-commerce brands will be an advantage.
* A degree or qualification in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Advertising, Marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with a strong portfolio.

Skills & Competencies

* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to write attention-grabbing hooks and engaging scripts.
* Strong understanding of audience psychology, narrative structure, and short-form video formats.
* Ability to simplify technical information without compromising accuracy.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Understanding of social media trends, creator content, and digital storytelling.
* Ability to develop original ideas rather than simply reproduce trending formats.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, feedback cycles, and deadlines.
* Openness to feedback and willingness to refine ideas based on creative direction.
* Interest in skincare science, beauty, consumer behaviour, branding, and design.

Tools & Platforms

Familiarity with the following tools and platforms will be an advantage:

* Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts
* Google Docs and Google Sheets
* Google Drive
* Canva
* CapCut and InShot
* ChatGPT or other AI-assisted research and writing tools
* Basic video editing and script-formatting tools
* Online research tools and social media trend discovery platforms

AI tools may be used to support brainstorming and research, but the candidate must demonstrate independent thinking, fact-checking, original writing, and editorial judgement.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond writing words and understands how to turn an idea into a compelling story.

Someone who constantly asks:

* What will make the audience stop scrolling?
* How can we communicate this idea in a simple and memorable way?
* What makes this product relevant to the consumer?
* How can we make skincare education interesting without compromising scientific accuracy?
* What storytelling angle will make our content distinctive?
* How can we turn a good idea into a script that works on camera?

The ideal candidate will be curious, proactive, research-oriented, creatively ambitious, and comfortable taking ownership of a script from initial idea to final production.

What You'll Gain

* The opportunity to shape the content voice of an emerging premium skincare brand.
* Creative ownership in developing original scripts, video concepts, and campaigns.
* Exposure to skincare science, product development, brand positioning, and consumer marketing.
* Hands-on experience with video production, influencer collaborations, and digital campaigns.
* Opportunities to experiment with storytelling formats and creative approaches.
* Collaboration with marketing, design, and production teams.
* A growth pathway into senior content, creative strategy, brand communication, or creative direction roles.

Work Environment

* Full-time, on-site role based in JP Nagar, 8th Phase, Bangalore.
* Collaborative and creativity-driven work culture.
* Fast-paced environment with opportunities to contribute original ideas.
* Strong emphasis on research, accuracy, quality, and attention to detail.
* Opportunity to work closely with the founding and marketing teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their resume and portfolio of relevant writing samples, video scripts, or content projects at **skintheta@gmail.com**.

For enquiries, contact **+91 7996301234**.

Please include at least two or three examples of short-form video scripts or content pieces that demonstrate your storytelling ability, creativity, and writing style.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: SAP Basis Administrator
description:
We are looking for an experienced **SAP Basis Administrator** with strong hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA database administration, SAP system administration, and enterprise application support. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining the stability, availability, performance, security, and reliability of SAP landscapes across development, quality assurance, and production environments.

The successful candidate will have proven experience in SAP Basis operations, system installations and upgrades, kernel maintenance, transport management, system refreshes, performance optimization, backup and recovery, and production incident resolution. Experience working in Application Management Services (AMS), ITIL-aligned operations, and SLA-driven support environments will be highly valued.

This role requires close collaboration with infrastructure, cloud, security, database, functional, and technical teams to ensure seamless SAP operations in a global, 24x7 support environment.

Key Responsibilities1. SAP Basis Administration and System Operations

* Administer, monitor, and maintain SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and related SAP application landscapes.
* Perform daily system health checks, availability monitoring, background job monitoring, and proactive issue identification.
* Manage SAP system parameters, profiles, work processes, RFC destinations, system logs, and operational configurations.
* Support SAP application server administration and investigate system availability and connectivity issues.
* Ensure SAP environments remain stable, secure, and compliant with operational standards.

2. SAP Installation, Upgrades, and Maintenance

* Perform SAP installations, system copies, system refreshes, client copies, and post-refresh validation activities.
* Execute kernel upgrades, Support Package Stacks (SPS), and other planned maintenance activities.
* Support SAP software lifecycle management and maintenance using applicable SAP tools and procedures.
* Plan and execute technical maintenance activities in coordination with application, infrastructure, and project teams.
* Validate system functionality and stability following upgrades, patches, and maintenance windows.

3. SAP HANA Database Administration

* Monitor SAP HANA database health, resource utilization, alerts, and database performance.
* Support database backup, recovery, housekeeping, and capacity monitoring activities.
* Troubleshoot database connectivity, resource contention, and performance-related issues.
* Coordinate with database specialists to resolve complex database incidents and optimize system performance.
* Support backup validation, recovery readiness, and disaster recovery procedures.

4. Transport Management and Release Support

* Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) activities across development, quality assurance, and production environments.
* Import, monitor, and troubleshoot transport requests while ensuring adherence to release and change management procedures.
* Coordinate transport sequencing, dependency checks, and deployment validation with functional and technical teams.
* Support production releases, emergency transports, and scheduled deployment activities.
* Maintain appropriate transport documentation and audit trails.

5. Performance Monitoring and Troubleshooting

* Analyze SAP system performance using relevant SAP monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* Investigate short dumps, system logs, work process issues, failed background jobs, memory utilization, and system bottlenecks.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents, service disruptions, and performance degradation.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve system reliability and operational efficiency.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the relevant SAP, database, infrastructure, or vendor support teams.

6. High Availability, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

* Support SAP high-availability (HA) configurations, disaster recovery (DR) readiness, and business continuity activities.
* Participate in backup monitoring, recovery testing, failover validation, and disaster recovery drills.
* Assist with SAP system restoration and recovery activities in accordance with approved procedures.
* Ensure operational documentation and recovery runbooks are current and accessible.

7. Monitoring, Incident, and SLA Management

* Support SAP monitoring through SAP Solution Manager and other applicable enterprise monitoring tools.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem records in accordance with established ITSM processes.
* Meet defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), response times, resolution targets, and operational KPIs.
* Participate in major incident management, escalation handling, and post-incident reviews.
* Maintain accurate incident records, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.

8. Security, Compliance, and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Perform Basis-related user administration and authorization support within approved access controls.
* Coordinate with SAP security teams for access-related troubleshooting and compliance requirements.
* Follow change management, configuration management, audit, and information security policies.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, ABAP developers, infrastructure teams, cloud operations, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in technical reviews, operational meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

9. Global Support and Shift Operations

* Provide production support in a 24x7 global operating model.
* Work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, weekends, and on-call support when required.
* Participate in planned maintenance windows, critical business support activities, and production deployment events.
* Ensure effective handovers between shifts and timely communication of critical issues.
* Maintain operational continuity and service quality across geographically distributed teams.

Required Technical Skills and Qualifications

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in SAP Basis administration and technical operations.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Practical experience with SAP HANA database administration and monitoring.
* Experience in SAP system installation, configuration, upgrades, kernel upgrades, and Support Package maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of SAP system refreshes, client copies, and system copy procedures.
* Experience with SAP Transport Management System (TMS) and transport coordination.
* Proficiency in SAP system monitoring, performance analysis, background job management, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of SAP Solution Manager or equivalent SAP monitoring and operations tools.
* Experience supporting SAP production environments and resolving critical incidents.
* Understanding of backup and recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery processes.
* Familiarity with SAP user administration and Basis-related authorization support.
* Experience working in AMS, managed services, or SLA-driven enterprise support environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,400,000.00 per year

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have in SAP Basis Administration, SAP S/4HANA, and SAP HANA Database Administration?

* What is your current annual CTC (Cost to Company) in LPA, including fixed and variable components?

* What is your official notice period, and what is your earliest possible joining date? Are you currently serving notice, and if so, what is your last working day?

At RTX, 185,000 people come together with a shared purpose—to solve the world's most complex challenges and make a meaningful difference.With three industry-leading businesses, world-class operations, and significant investments in research and development, RTX brings together technology, innovation, and expertise to push the boundaries of what is possible.Together, we develop technologies that help connect and protect our world and shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**About Collins Aerospace**

Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a global leader in technologically advanced and intelligent aerospace and defense solutions.

With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, Collins Aerospace helps customers address some of the most demanding challenges in the global aerospace industry.

Join us and be part of a team that is redefining aerospace through technology, innovation, and engineering excellence.

**Job Overview**

The SAP Basis Administrator will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, availability, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical SAP systems across a global environment. This role supports key business functions, including finance, order management, inventory, procurement, shipping, and engineering.

You will collaborate with global SAP, infrastructure, network, security, and business teams to maintain a stable SAP landscape, drive continuous improvement, identify automation opportunities, and support strategic technology initiatives. The role offers opportunities to make independent technical decisions and contribute to the evolution of the company’s SAP infrastructure and digital strategy.

**What You Will Do**

* **SAP Landscape Management:** Execute SAP infrastructure and architecture roadmaps, ensuring system stability, availability, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* **System Administration:** Install, configure, patch, maintain, and refresh SAP applications and database systems.
* **Performance Optimization:** Monitor system performance, analyze resource utilization, perform tuning and capacity management, and proactively identify potential issues.
* **Incident and Service Management:** Handle service management tickets, troubleshoot system issues, perform health checks, and support break/fix activities.
* **Infrastructure Collaboration:** Partner with data center, network, storage, security, and database teams to deliver reliable and secure SAP solutions.
* **High Availability and Disaster Recovery:** Support SAP infrastructure design and initiatives involving high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* **Automation and Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to automate routine activities, improve operational efficiency, and enhance existing processes.
* **Documentation:** Develop and maintain technical specifications, system architecture diagrams, design documents, requirements, and test scripts.
* **Business-Critical Support:** Support SAP Digital Technology (DT) teams during critical system outages, planned maintenance, and operational activities.
* **Global Support:** Participate in on-call rotations, work in US hours as required, and provide weekend support when necessary.

**What You Will Learn**

* Gain exposure to a large, global SAP landscape supporting critical enterprise business functions.
* Develop deeper expertise in SAP infrastructure architecture, system performance, and landscape management.
* Understand high-availability solutions, disaster recovery strategies, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
* Explore automation opportunities and continuous improvement initiatives across SAP operations.
* Collaborate with global technical teams and business stakeholders on strategic SAP initiatives.
* Contribute to SAP modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* 15+ years of experience working in an SAP Basis administration role.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, including networking, servers, storage, databases, and application architecture.
* Hands-on experience administering SAP ECC, BW, PI, Solution Manager, and SAP HANA systems.
* Knowledge of system architecture, performance monitoring, tuning, and capacity management methodologies and tools.
* Experience in scripting using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organizational levels, including leadership.
* Ability to work in a global support environment, including US working hours, on-call rotations, and occasional weekend support.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Extensive hands-on experience in SAP BASIS administration and technical operations across SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/BW4HANA, SAP PI/PO, SAP Solution Manager, SAP SRM, SAP SCM/APO, SAP Content Server, SAP BusinessObjects, SAP Data Services, and Redwood scheduling
* Experience with SAP installations, upgrades, support package implementations, kernel upgrades, system conversions, migrations, system copies, client copies, system refreshes, and landscape maintenance
* Experience leading SAP upgrade, Migration and transformation programs
* Strong administration experience with SAP HANA, ORACLE and SAP Sybase ASE databases, including backup/recovery, performance tuning, and database maintenance
* Experience in designing and supporting High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), and business continuity solutions
* Execute system refreshes, client copies, system copies, and landscape maintenance activities
* Perform SAP HANA database administration, backup/recovery, performance tuning, and HANA System Replication (HSR).
* Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows operating systems in SAP environments
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and other enterprise cloud environments
* Experience with RISE with SAP transformation and migration initiatives, including system migration, landscape optimization, and cloud adoption
* Experience managing SAP transport landscapes, change management processes, and SAP ChaRM (Change Request Management).
* Experience working in global delivery and support models, including coordination with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across multiple geographies.
* Experience supporting SAP identity integration with Active Directory, LDAP, Kerberos, and other enterprise authentication mechanisms.
* Experience developing automation scripts using Bash, Python, PowerShell, or other scripting languages to streamline SAP BASIS operations.

**Educational Qualification**

* **Bachelor’s degree:** Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), or a related field, along with relevant experience.
* **Advanced degree:** A master’s or other advanced degree in a related field may be considered with the applicable level of relevant experience.
* **Experience in lieu of education:** Candidates without a degree may qualify with equivalent relevant professional experience, subject to company policy and applicable requirements.

**Digital Technology**

Do you want to be part of a new, exciting initiative to combine foundational IT with new digital technologies? Our Digital Technology team is driving business efficiencies and a better customer experience by connecting technologies, people, information and processes. From making aircraft more electric, intelligent and integrated to building new software platforms such as Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain, there’s no better place to be right now than in digital. Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Lead Performance Engineer with strong expertise in Performance Engineering, Capacity Planning, Scalability Assessment, Performance Architecture, and Technical Leadership across UI applications, APIs, MQ-based messaging systems, and Batch Processing workloads.
  
  
The ideal candidate will lead performance engineering initiatives, define enterprise-wide performance strategies, mentor performance teams, and drive performance governance across multiple programs. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in LoadRunner Enterprise (LRE), Apache JMeter, AutoSys, Capacity Engineering, Bottleneck Analysis, Infrastructure Sizing, and Performance Optimization.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with Enterprise Architects, Application Development Teams, Infrastructure Teams, Middleware Teams, Database Administrators, DevOps Teams, and Business Stakeholders to ensure scalable, resilient, and high-performing enterprise platforms.
  
  
Day to Day Job Duties

title: SAP Project Lead
description:
*By creating bearings and solutions for everything from industrial applications to vehicles, SKF plays an essential role in our everyday lives. In Q4 2026, SKF intends to spin off its Automotive business and list it as a separate company under the name of SKF Vertevo. A company created to support the future of the automotive market, and to co-drive the future of mobility faster.*

  

*This role will be a part of that new company.* *Would you like to join us, and move people further?*

  

**SAP Basis Lead-SKF Automotive Business**

**Role Purpose**

The SAP Basis Lead is accountable for the **reliability, availability, security, performance and lifecycle management of the enterprise SAP platform**, across Business-as-Usual (BAU) operations and SAP transformation initiatives.

The role acts as the technical service owner and primary interface between internal IT, SAP application teams, **SAP RISE/ECS**, hyperscalers and AMS/service partners, ensuring a secure, resilient and efficiently operated SAP landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. RISE with SAP & Platform Governance**

* Own technical governance of **RISE with SAP / S/4HANA Private Cloud** and the broader SAP platform landscape.
* Govern the **RISE shared-responsibility model** across SAP ECS, internal IT, hyperscalers and service partners.
* Manage SAP/ECS service delivery, SLAs, planned maintenance, escalations and continual service improvement.
* Govern system provisioning, refreshes, patching, upgrades, capacity and technical lifecycle activities.
* Define and maintain SAP platform standards, architecture principles and technology roadmap.
* Ensure clear ownership and accountability across SAP, AMS and internal teams.

**2. BAU Operations & Service Reliability**

* Ensure stable **24x7 operation of business-critical SAP environments**.
* Govern incident, problem, change and major-incident management, including root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Oversee system availability, performance, interfaces, background jobs, databases, capacity and overall platform health.
* Govern kernel/support package upgrades, patching, system refreshes, client copies, housekeeping and transport management.
* Establish and monitor operational **SLAs, KPIs, runbooks and escalation procedures**.
* Drive proactive monitoring and observability across SAP systems, integrations, jobs and critical business processes.
* Drive automation and continual improvement to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents and technical debt.
* Leverage **SAP Cloud ALM, where applicable**, for monitoring, alerting and operational insights.

**3. S/4HANA Transformation, Release & Cutover**

* Act as BASIS technical lead for **S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, migrations and transformation programs**.
* Ensure technical environment readiness across DEV, QA, UAT, Pre-Production and Production.
* Lead technical cutovers, transport/release management, production deployment and hypercare.
* Coordinate technical dependencies across Functional, Development, Integration, Security, Data, Testing and Infrastructure teams.
* Ensure transformation activities are delivered without compromising BAU stability.
* Support landscape simplification and transition from legacy SAP platforms.

**4. Architecture, Integration & Lifecycle Management**

* Provide technical leadership across **S/4HANA, HANA, Fiori/Gateway, Cloud Connector and associated SAP platform technologies**.
* Govern connectivity across SAP cloud, on-premises and third-party platforms.
* Ensure architecture provides appropriate availability, resilience, performance, scalability and capacity.
* Govern authentication, certificates, SSO, connectivity and network dependencies.
* Evaluate new SAP technologies and platform capabilities in alignment with enterprise architecture and business requirements.
* Maintain lifecycle plans for SAP platforms, databases and related technical components.

**5. Security, Risk, Compliance & Resilience**

* Ensure SAP platforms comply with enterprise cybersecurity, **ITGC and audit requirements**.
* Govern vulnerability remediation, secure configurations, certificate management and privileged technical access.
* Maintain SAP platform risks and associated remediation plans.
* Govern backup/recovery, high availability and **Disaster Recovery** capabilities.
* Coordinate DR readiness and testing aligned with agreed **RTO/RPO** requirements.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure appropriate controls and evidence are maintained.

**6. Partner, Vendor & Team Leadership**

* Lead operational governance with **SAP/ECS, AMS providers, hyperscalers and other technology partners**.
* Monitor service delivery against contractual responsibilities, SLAs and KPIs.
* Act as the technical escalation point for critical SAP platform issues.
* Lead service reviews, corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to BASIS/platform specialists.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, SAP Application and business teams.
* Drive **automation, simplification, cost optimization and operational excellence** across the SAP platform.

**Experience & Core Skills**

* About 15 years of experience in **SAP**
* Strong experience leading **SAP BASIS/platform operations within a large enterprise environment**.
* Deep technical knowledge of **SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA**.
* Strong experience with **RISE with SAP / S/4HANA Private Cloud**.
* Experience working with **SAP ECS and the RISE shared-responsibility model**.
* Strong experience in SAP BAU operations, performance management, upgrades, migrations, technical cutovers, system refreshes and transport management.
* Experience supporting large-scale **S/4HANA transformation and upgrade programs**.
* Strong understanding of **SAP architecture**, **Fiori/Gateway, Cloud Connector, interfaces and enterprise connectivity**.
* Strong understanding of ITSM processes including incident, problem, change and major-incident management.
* Knowledge of security, audit, compliance, HA/DR and business continuity requirements.
* Experience governing SAP, AMS and cloud service providers within an SLA-driven operating model.
* Strong **technical leadership, stakeholder management, vendor management and communication skills**.

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of **SAP BTP** and its interaction with the core SAP landscape.
* Experience with **SAP Cloud ALM (CALM)** for monitoring, alerting and operational insights.
* Experience transitioning monitoring/ALM capabilities from **SAP Solution Manager** to newer SAP tooling.
* Exposure to automation and observability solutions supporting SAP operations.
* Experience with global, multi-system and business-critical SAP landscapes.

  

**Role Success Profile**

The successful candidate combines **strong SAP BASIS technical depth with service ownership, governance and transformation leadership**.

The role is not intended to be primarily a hands-on BASIS administrator. The SAP Basis Administrator will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, availability, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical SAP systems across a global environment. description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Bengaluru, KA

**About The Role:**

  

The End User Compute (EUC) team delivers the endpoint platforms, tools and services that enable our colleagues to work securely and effectively.

  

We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help shape and deliver improvements across device management, provisioning, automation and hardware lifecycles. Your primary expertise will be Windows endpoint management, particularly Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot and PowerShell. Experience administering both Windows and macOS is highly valued. Strong Windows engineers who are willing to learn and take increasing responsibility for Mac administration are encouraged to apply.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Maintain and enhance our Microsoft Intune environments, including device enrolment, configuration, compliance and application management, ensuring services remain secure, reliable and scalable.
* Develop and improve light-touch provisioning using Windows Autopilot, with minimal manual IT intervention and a robust setup experience.
* Configure and troubleshoot the interactions between Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and Okta, working with identity teams to support reliable device provisioning, authentication and access.
* Plan and deliver endpoint migrations between Microsoft Entra ID tenants, managing dependencies, device transitions, user access, testing and communications while minimising disruption.
* Manage Windows update policies, deployment rings and operating system upgrades, including compatibility testing, pilot deployments, phased rollouts, compliance monitoring and remediation of failed updates.
* Package, test, deploy and maintain Windows applications, including installation and detection logic, dependencies, upgrades and removal. Use WinGet and other appropriate tools to improve application management and employee self-service.
* Develop reusable PowerShell scripts and automation to detect and remediate recurring endpoint issues, reduce manual administration and improve reporting. Apply appropriate testing, logging and error handling.
* Collaborate with Security teams to manage endpoint vulnerabilities, maintain endpoint security tools and implement controls such as encryption, security baselines and local administrator restrictions.
* Provide L3 support for complex issues involving device enrolment, policy conflicts, application deployment, updates, authentication and device trust. Investigate root causes, coordinate vendor escalations and implement lasting fixes through established incident, problem and change management processes.
* Monitor and report on device health, patch and device compliance, provisioning success and application deployment outcomes. Use findings to prioritise improvements and reduce recurring incidents.
* Contribute to the EUC roadmap and own assigned improvements from investigation and design through testing, implementation and operational handover, with clear rollout and recovery plans.
Maintain technical documentation and runbooks, share knowledge, and provide training for technical teams and end users.  

  

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Proven experience in a senior endpoint engineering or L3 EUC role, with strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting of enterprise Windows environments.
* Strong Microsoft Intune expertise across device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, update management and troubleshooting.
* Practical experience implementing and supporting Windows Autopilot and automated device provisioning.
* Experience migrating Windows endpoints from one Microsoft Entra ID tenant to another, including planning, dependency assessment, execution and validation, with consideration for device enrolment, user profiles and data, authentication and application access.
* Experience managing Windows updates and operating system upgrades through controlled testing, deployment rings, compliance monitoring and remediation.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills, with experience developing and maintaining scripts for endpoint administration, detection, remediation and reporting.
* Experience packaging and deploying Win32 applications, including installation contexts, detection rules, dependencies, upgrades and deployment failure investigation. Practical familiarity with WinGet.
* Experience managing endpoint hardware lifecycles, including asset records, warranty and support status, refresh planning, redeployment and secure decommissioning.
* A strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID device identities, join types, groups and the relationship between device compliance and Conditional Access.
* A strong understanding of Okta or an equivalent identity provider (IdP), including single sign-on, multifactor authentication and user lifecycle management, with the ability to investigate endpoint-related authentication issues.
* Familiarity with Google Chrome browser management.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, using logs, testing and evidence to identify root causes, recognise recurring problems and verify solutions.
* A practical, service-focused approach, with a willingness to learn macOS administration and actively contribute to both Windows and Mac endpoint services.
Strong communication skills in spoken and written English, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, provide timely updates on progress and risks, produce useful documentation and share knowledge effectively across global teams.  

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

  

* Enterprise macOS administration using Jamf Pro, including configuration profiles, application deployment, patching and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrolment.
* Experience using Microsoft Graph and REST APIs to automate endpoint administration, reporting and integrations.
* Experience with version control and maintaining shared scripts and technical documentation.
* Experience with endpoint detection and response, secure remote access or privileged access management tools.
* Experience implementing endpoint monitoring and telemetry tools to improve device reliability and employee experience.
* Familiarity with collaboration and service delivery platforms such as Jira, Slack and Zoom.
* Bash or shell scripting experience for macOS.
* Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or relevant Jamf certifications.

We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Senior Metrics Analyst to lead the development, management, and optimization of IT Service Management (ITSM) reporting, analytics, and performance measurement capabilities. * Present findings, trends, risks, and improvement recommendations to senior management, stakeholders, and governance boards.
* Identify opportunities for reporting automation and process optimization to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Support ITIL-aligned service management practices by ensuring metrics accurately reflect service health, quality, and business value.

Senior Domain Expert – Telecom OSS, Adaptive Inventory and Network Transformation

This role requires a seasoned telecom technology leader with deep expertise in OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN and transmission domains, network inventory transformation, solution architecture, data modelling, integration, and end-to-end delivery. The candidate should be able to translate complex business and network requirements into scalable architecture solutions, lead cross-functional teams, modernize legacy inventory platforms, and enable strategic transformation across wireless, IP, transport, assurance, and planning domains.

To lead architecture, design, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across telecom network inventory and OSS platforms, with a strong focus on Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, Telstra-wide inventory transformation, unified data management, API-led integration, and domain federation. The role is accountable for shaping solution architecture, driving stakeholder alignment, enabling data quality improvements, and ensuring reliable delivery of business-critical inventory capabilities.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical architect and telecom solution leader with strong OSS/BSS and network inventory experience, particularly across Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN, transmission, IP, transport, and enterprise inventory transformation. The candidate should combine deep technical knowledge with stakeholder leadership, delivery discipline, data architecture expertise, and the ability to modernize complex legacy inventory environments while protecting business continuity and driving measurable operational value.

* Lead solution architecture and technical design for telecom OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, network inventory, planning, assurance, and transmission transformation initiatives.

* Translate customer, business, and network engineering requirements into tangible product solutions across RAN, wireless, IP, transport, and inventory domains.

* Collaborate with product, order management, provisioning, billing, assurance, planning, and service activation teams to define business needs and deliver integrated outcomes.

* Lead cross-functional onshore and offshore teams across strategic projects, application portfolios, reporting initiatives, and production support environments.

Required Experience

* 18+ years of experience in telecom technology delivery, OSS/BSS, network inventory, solution architecture, integration, business analysis, and production support.

* Strong experience with Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, Telstra inventory platforms, RAN inventory, transmission domain upgrades, network planning, assurance, fulfilment, and inventory federation.

* Proven background in information model development for wireless, IP, and transport networks, including object relationships, topology, connectivity patterns, service enablement, and customer experience abstraction.

* Experience leading complex application portfolios, vendor transitions, knowledge transfer, system modernization, strategic architecture migration, and operational support for large-scale inventory ecosystems.

* Demonstrated ability to improve business outcomes through data standardization, process modernization, automation, reporting, performance improvements, cost reduction, and operational efficiency.

* **Programming and Platforms:** Java, PL/SQL, Oracle, Perl-supported legacy systems, Apache Tomcat, Solaris, Linux, HTML, JSON, JavaScript, XML, and MySQL.

* **Cloud and Integration:** AWS, AWS EC2, microservices, reusable integration components, APIGEE Gateway, standardized APIs, REST-based integration, real-time and non-real-time synchronization, and reconciliation patterns.

* **Tools:** Eclipse, STS, GitHub, Jenkins, Bamboo, Splunk, MySQL Workbench, Postman, JIRA, Rally, GIT, and enterprise delivery toolchains.

* Ability to act as a trusted technical advisor for telecom customers, business teams, architecture groups, implementation teams, and operations stakeholders.

* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to assess network data, diagnose inventory quality issues, define corrective actions, and recommend scalable architecture options.

Level Extensive Experience:
  

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.

* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.

* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.

Level Extensive Experience:

* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.

title: Sr. Store Executive
description:
ole Summary

The Showroom Executive welcomes and manages walk-in customers at our Bengaluru studio. You will present our products with a good understanding of interiors, guide visitors through finishes and samples, and make sure every enquiry is captured and followed up.

Key Responsibilities

* Receive and welcome walk-in customers, architects and designers in the studio.
* Understand each customer's requirement (space, substrate, look and budget) and recommend suitable finishes and systems.
* Explain products clearly: lime plasters, textured wall finishes, microtopping flooring, glass partitions, wooden flooring and smart-home options.

* Languages: English, Hindi and Kannada (fluent)
* Skills: Product knowledge, customer handling, confident communication, basic spreadsheet use (Google Sheets / Excel)
* Personality: Well-groomed, courteous and professional, with a polished client-facing presence

What We Offer

* Training on the full Client product range
* Work in a premium design studio environment

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

The team primarily supports the initial implementation of S4 HANA in markets not already using S4. * Identify and document issues/errors and drive successful resolution of issues through all project phases (design, testing, and stabilization). Escalate issues when appropriate.

**About you:**

Education:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance; or equivalent experience. Advanced degree preferred.
* Chartered Accountant is a plus

Experience:

* Deep understanding of business processes as well as good knowledge of technical issues in the area of Accounts receivable with FI-SD integration and controlling
* Experience in implementing interfaces and custom reports/ custom functionalities.
* Hands on experience in the requirements gathering/ fit-gap, design/blueprinting and configuration/ customization phase of SAP transformation programs.
* Experience in E-Invoicing and FSCM is a plus
* Experience and knowledge of key integration points with FI/CO modules [FI-MM/FI-SD /FI-CO].
* Hands on experience in Identifying, analyzing and studying any new requirement highlighted by any Business Process owners and prepare the benefit analysis.
* Ideally experienced in working in virtual teams and international environment.
* Language Proficiency in English

* Ability to take ownership of responsibilities shared and independently handle the respective module.
* Show willingness to learn and indicate genuineness in unfamiliar concepts/scenarios.
* Interest in learning and implementing AI in business process to increase productivity of the users.
* Must be able to work independently as well as a team player and can manage own workload.
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to raise relevant issues, drive for solution/alignment, and make decisions under time constraints
* Experience with conducting presentations and training
* Successfully manages competing priorities to ensure continuous progress is made and critical deadlines are met
* Capable of clearly documenting business and functional requirements for current/future state processes
* Ability to represent change within the organization

title: Principal Emulation IP Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 10/26/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19489****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/26/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs.

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. Sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe does not faze you. You walk out with a plan that everyone believes in.

You do not wait for perfect alignment. Ask the right questions, push back when something does not make sense, and move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there.

  
  

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high-speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
* Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
* Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
* Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
* Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
* Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
* Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate time to market for high-performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
* Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
* Drive adoption of best-in-class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
* Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
* Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
* Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
* Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting-edge digital designs and system architectures
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
* Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
* Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
* Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
* Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
* You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work. You read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
* You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
* You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
* Mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification comes naturally to you, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
* You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join a dynamic, high-performing engineering team focused on IP development, emulation, and verification at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Our team is collaborative, cross-functional, and globally distributed, working together to solve complex challenges and deliver industry-leading solutions. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experts across multiple domains, drive impactful initiatives, and shape the future of digital design and verification at Synopsys.

  
  

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

**Job Summary**

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Who We Are**

Telstra is Australia’s leading telecommunications and technology company spanning over a century with a footprint in over 20+ countries. In India, we’re building a platform for innovative delivery and engagement that will strengthen our position as an industry leader. We’ve grown quickly since our inception in 2019, now with offices in Pune and Bangalore  

  
  

Senior Domain Expert – Telecom OSS, Adaptive Inventory and Network Transformation

This role requires a seasoned telecom technology leader with deep expertise in OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN and transmission domains, network inventory transformation, solution architecture, data modelling, integration, and end-to-end delivery. The candidate should be able to translate complex business and network requirements into scalable architecture solutions, lead cross-functional teams, modernize legacy inventory platforms, and enable strategic transformation across wireless, IP, transport, assurance, and planning domains.

Role Purpose

To lead architecture, design, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across telecom network inventory and OSS platforms, with a strong focus on Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, Telstra-wide inventory transformation, unified data management, API-led integration, and domain federation. The role is accountable for shaping solution architecture, driving stakeholder alignment, enabling data quality improvements, and ensuring reliable delivery of business-critical inventory capabilities.

  

Focus of the role

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical architect and telecom solution leader with strong OSS/BSS and network inventory experience, particularly across Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN, transmission, IP, transport, and enterprise inventory transformation. The candidate should combine deep technical knowledge with stakeholder leadership, delivery discipline, data architecture expertise, and the ability to modernize complex legacy inventory environments while protecting business continuity and driving measurable operational value.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

* Lead solution architecture and technical design for telecom OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, network inventory, planning, assurance, and transmission transformation initiatives.

* Translate customer, business, and network engineering requirements into tangible product solutions across RAN, wireless, IP, transport, and inventory domains.

* Define and execute architecture roadmaps covering inventory federation, data migration, metadata management, data modelling, synchronization, reconciliation, and strategic platform modernization.

* Drive end-to-end integration across upstream and downstream systems using standardized APIs, reusable components, microservices, APIGEE Gateway, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Establish unified data management practices, including object modelling, relationship mapping, data quality improvement, real-time and non-real-time synchronization, and reconciliation controls.

* Lead transition and migration programs that preserve existing domain investments while enabling next-generation inventory user experience and strategic architecture adoption.

* Own SDLC and Agile delivery activities, including solution design, low-level design, development oversight, unit testing, system testing, integration testing, UAT coordination, documentation, training, and implementation support.

* Facilitate workshops, knowledge transfer sessions, stakeholder forums, architecture reviews, and customer engagement routines to ensure solution alignment and operational readiness.

* Collaborate with product, order management, provisioning, billing, assurance, planning, and service activation teams to define business needs and deliver integrated outcomes.

* Lead cross-functional onshore and offshore teams across strategic projects, application portfolios, reporting initiatives, and production support environments.

Required Experience

* 18+ years of experience in telecom technology delivery, OSS/BSS, network inventory, solution architecture, integration, business analysis, and production support.

* Strong experience with Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, Telstra inventory platforms, RAN inventory, transmission domain upgrades, network planning, assurance, fulfilment, and inventory federation.

* Proven background in information model development for wireless, IP, and transport networks, including object relationships, topology, connectivity patterns, service enablement, and customer experience abstraction.

* Experience leading complex application portfolios, vendor transitions, knowledge transfer, system modernization, strategic architecture migration, and operational support for large-scale inventory ecosystems.

* Hands-on experience with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java-based platforms, Perl-supported legacy systems, microservices, APIs, Linux/Solaris environments, Apache Tomcat, and network data quality remediation.

* Demonstrated ability to improve business outcomes through data standardization, process modernization, automation, reporting, performance improvements, cost reduction, and operational efficiency.

Technical Skills

* **Domain Knowledge:** Telecom OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN inventory, transmission, optical transport, IP/MPLS, HFC, FTTP, assurance, fulfilment, network planning, topology, and service inventory.

* **Architecture and Delivery:** Solution architecture, technical architecture, business analysis, information modelling, data modelling, metadata management, data migration, inventory federation, SDLC, Agile, DevOps, and strategic architecture modernization.

* **Programming and Platforms:** Java, PL/SQL, Oracle, Perl-supported legacy systems, Apache Tomcat, Solaris, Linux, HTML, JSON, JavaScript, XML, and MySQL.

* **Cloud and Integration:** AWS, AWS EC2, microservices, reusable integration components, APIGEE Gateway, standardized APIs, REST-based integration, real-time and non-real-time synchronization, and reconciliation patterns.

* **Tools:** Eclipse, STS, GitHub, Jenkins, Bamboo, Splunk, MySQL Workbench, Postman, JIRA, Rally, GIT, and enterprise delivery toolchains.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

* Ability to act as a trusted technical advisor for telecom customers, business teams, architecture groups, implementation teams, and operations stakeholders.

* Strong experience leading workshops, governance discussions, technical reviews, stakeholder alignment sessions, and cross-functional delivery forums.

* Proven capability to lead large onshore-offshore teams, implementation squads, business analysts, developers, testers, and production support groups across strategic and operational programs.

* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to assess network data, diagnose inventory quality issues, define corrective actions, and recommend scalable architecture options.

Certifications and Qualifications

Preferred certifications include AWS Architect, ITIL Foundation, Oracle Certified Administrator, TOGAF, and CCNA.

title: IT Infrastructure & Operations Lead
description:
Bengaluru

6 - 9 years experience

###### **Responsibilities**

**IT Infrastructure & Operations Lead (Hands-On)**

**IT Operations | Full-Time | Bengaluru**

**Department**

Information Technology

  

**Location**

Bengaluru, India (on-site)

  

**Employment type**

Full-time

  

**Experience**

6 - 9 years in IT infrastructure and end-user/endpoint operations, ideally including time at an MNC or GCC environment

**About Gnani.ai**

Gnani.ai is a frontier Voice AI company building proprietary speech and language models for enterprise deployments across 40+ languages. We serve 200+ enterprises in banking, insurance, healthcare, and government, processing over 30 million voice interactions daily. Our platform includes voice biometric authentication, making trust, privacy, and regulatory compliance central to everything we build - not an afterthought bolted on top.

**About the Role**

This is a senior individual contributor role that combines leading the IT practice with direct delivery of end-user and endpoint support. You will define the processes, standards, and documentation that keep IT reliable and audit-ready, drive their adoption across the IT team, and work the IT ticket queue yourself alongside the team.

The right person is equally comfortable designing an ITSM process, resolving a difficult escalation with composure, and configuring a laptop for a new joiner. You will partner with the CISO on access governance and endpoint security.

**What You'll Own** **Leadership and process**

* Define, document, and maintain core IT SOPs and standards: onboarding/offboarding, access provisioning and deprovisioning, change management, incident escalation, backup and recovery, vendor management

* Run IT service management: ticketing, request and incident workflows, SLAs, and response-time and resolution KPIs reported regularly to leadership

* Own the asset and access inventory: devices, software licences, firewall rules, server room access, admin credentials, and vendor contracts and contacts

* Maintain a rolling IT roadmap with weekly action plans, tracked to completion

* Lead the IT practice: set the standards, ways of working, and best practices the IT team follows, and drive adoption through example and collaboration (individual contributor role, not a people manager)

* Handle escalations from employees, leadership, and vendors with a calm, firm, and courteous approach: set expectations clearly, communicate status proactively, and close the loop

* Ensure no process or system depends on a single person: document, cross-train, and share knowledge across the team

* Manage IT vendors, AMCs, and contracts, including renewals, SLAs, and escalation contacts

* Partner with the CISO on access governance, endpoint security, and IT control evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, and client audits

**Hands-on delivery**

* Provide L2/L3 support and handle escalations for Windows, macOS, and Linux desktops and laptops, including operating system, application, hardware, printer, and peripheral issues

* Provision, configure, and secure endpoints for new joiners; manage devices end to end through MDM (Jamf, Scalefusion, JumpCloud, or Intune)

* Administer user accounts, groups, permissions, and access controls through Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including Microsoft 365 administration

* Manage endpoint security tooling: antivirus/EDR, DLP, operating system updates, security patching, and software upgrades

* Troubleshoot and administer LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and firewall configuration

* Own and work the IT ticket queue alongside the team: triage, resolve, and manage tickets and incidents end to end, accountable for response times and quality

* Maintain the health of the server room, backups, and core infrastructure

**What We're Looking For**

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience across IT infrastructure, systems administration, and end-user/endpoint support, with meaningful time in a structured, process-driven organization (MNC, GCC, or large IT services environment)

* Demonstrated experience building or enforcing ITSM-style processes (incident, change, request, and asset management) using a ticketing tool such as Jira Service Management, Freshservice, or ServiceNow

* Strong hands-on skills in Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop and laptop support

* Working experience with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 administration

* Experience with MDM platforms (Jamf, Scalefusion, JumpCloud, or Intune) and endpoint security tooling (antivirus/EDR, DLP)

* Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP) and hands-on firewall administration

* Experience with patch management, backup, and IT asset and licence management

* Strong written documentation habits - SOPs, runbooks, and inventories that others can follow

* Experience as a senior individual contributor who set up processes and practices that a team adopted, influencing without formal authority

* Strong, polite communication: able to handle escalations calmly and firmly, set expectations diplomatically, and keep employees, vendors, and leadership informed

* Ownership and follow-through on your own ticket queue and commitments

**Certifications**

Preferred (relevant combination for the stack above):

* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher

* Microsoft MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator), or SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator)

* CCNA or CompTIA Network+

* Firewall vendor certification (for example Fortinet NSE 4 or Palo Alto PCNSA)

* Jamf Certified Tech or an equivalent MDM certification

* CompTIA A+ or Security+

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience in a regulated industry (BFSI, healthcare, insurance) and in supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits

* Scripting for automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python)

* Exposure to Google Workspace and remote support tools

**Why Join Now**

* You will set the practice for the IT function while staying close to the work, with direct impact on every employee.

* Direct, high-visibility work with the CTO and CISO - decisions you make will be felt company-wide within your first quarter.

* A rare chance to shape IT operations at a fast-scaling company, without enterprise bureaucracy.

Primary Skills

ITSM

Advance Microsoft Excel

MDM

Networking Fundamentals

Basic Networking concepts, knowledge in SQL & Linux
