title: Senior Staff Emulation Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 10/25/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19440****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/25/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of ASIC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that emulation is not just another tool in the flow, it is the thing that makes or breaks your ability to ship complex IP on time. You know PCIe or DDR inside and out, not just the spec but the weird corner cases, the errata that nobody talks about, and the places where emulation models fall short of what the design team actually needs.

You have worked on Zebu or similar platforms long enough to know what good emulation IP looks like and what happens when it is not quite right. You have closed that gap before, probably more than once, and you know how to do it without creating chaos for the teams depending on your work. You are comfortable sitting with a design team in Bangalore, a verification lead in California, and an IP product manager in Europe, and walking out with a plan that everyone believes in.

You do not wait for perfect alignment. You ask the right questions, you push back when something does not make sense, and you move. At Synopsys, you will work on IP that powers the next generation of silicon, and the emulation strategies you define will directly affect how fast we get there.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Bridge the gap between Emulation IP capabilities and Design IP verification needs across both Controller and PHY domains for high speed interfaces like PCIe and DDR
* Define technical requirements for Emulation IP, working directly with IP development and verification teams to ensure correct implementation and deployment on Zebu platforms
* Track and report key metrics on Emulation IP quality, performance, and coverage, driving continuous improvement across verification workflows
* Stay ahead of evolving PCIe and DDR standards, interpret specification updates, ECNs, and errata, and translate those into actionable changes for both Emulation and Design IP teams
* Review and validate test plans for Emulation IP and Design IP, ensuring completeness, traceability, and alignment with product quality goals
* Collaborate cross-functionally with verification, design, product, and platform teams to optimize emulation methodologies and standardize best practices
* Mentor engineers on emulation strategies, verification techniques, and IP development workflows

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate time to market for high performance IP by defining emulation strategies that catch issues earlier and reduce silicon respins
* Elevate product quality across Synopsys IP portfolios by ensuring Emulation IP meets the real needs of design and verification teams
* Drive adoption of best in class emulation and verification methodologies that become standard practice across the organization
* Influence the next generation of emulation solutions and workflows, positioning Synopsys as a leader in pre-silicon validation
* Improve cross-functional collaboration and alignment between geographically distributed teams, reducing friction and rework
* Standardize verification workflows and metrics, making it easier for teams to track progress, identify gaps, and deliver with confidence
* Shape how Synopsys develops and deploys Emulation IP for cutting edge digital designs and system architectures

### **What You'll Need**

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in emulation, pre-silicon verification, or IP product development
* Expert-level knowledge of PCIe or DDR interfaces, including protocol details, verification strategies, and real-world implementation challenges
* Extensive experience with Zebu or similar emulation platforms, specifically for IP verification and system-level validation
* Proven track record leading IP product development initiatives with a strong focus on emulation and verification
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally in matrixed, global teams and drive consensus across diverse stakeholders
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and inspire change across engineering teams
* Comfort working in dynamic, ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and priorities shift

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room where the Emulation IP does not quite match what the design team needs and walk out with a concrete plan to close the gap without derailing either team's schedule
* You do not need someone to tell you what the next version of the PCIe or DDR spec means for your work, you read it, figure out the implications, and start the conversation with your team
* You are the person people come to when emulation results do not make sense, and you know how to debug across the boundary between emulation models, RTL, and test environments
* You push back when a test plan looks complete on paper but is missing coverage for the cases that actually matter in production
* You are comfortable mentoring engineers who are newer to emulation or IP verification, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and capability
* You stay organized across multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and time zones without losing track of what matters most

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

Our elevators, escalators, and moving walks safely transport more than two billion of us up and down buildings and across transportation hubs every day.As part of the Schindler team, you’ll discover meaningful work that enhances quality of life for communities, and contribute to making places more accessible, inclusive, and sustainable for all. We combine innovation, safety, and high ethical standards, ensuring respect both among colleagues and for the world around us. By joining us, you don’t just become part of our success story; you help shape the future and continue our rich legacy that started back in 1874.
  
  
Schindler India is a 100% owned subsidiary of Schindler Group headquartered out of Mumbai and is backed by 5000+ employees who are spread across the length and breadth of the country. Besides business operations, Schindler India has its own Corporate R&D Centre, Elevator and Escalator Factory and Shared Service Centre to support India operations, which is in-fact one of the fastest growing market now globally.

  

**Join us as a**

**Technical Trainer**
=====================

  

#### **Your main responsibilities**

* Looking for an energetic and passionate Technical Trainer to deliver training on elevator maintenance, troubleshooting, safety, and service excellence.

* The role involves conducting hands-on training using simulators, classroom instruction, and practical field coaching at customer and project sites.

* The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of elevator systems and maintenance practices, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and make learning engaging and effective.

* The trainer will be responsible for planning and delivering training programs, assessing trainee competence, developing learning materials, and supporting technician assessments & certifications.

* The candidate must be **technology savvy, curious about emerging technologies, and willing to leverage digital learning tools, simulators, AI-enabled platforms, and modern training methodologies to enhance learning outcomes.**

* We seek an individual who is humble, collaborative, and learner-focused, with a strong commitment to developing technical talent.

* Excellent in presentation, coaching, and facilitation skills are essential.

#### **What you bring**

* Diploma or Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related discipline.

* Experience in elevator maintenance, service operations, or technical training.

* Strong troubleshooting and hands-on technical skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English and Hindi, along with proficiency in any one South Indian language (Tamil / Telugu / Kannada, or Malayalam).

* Willingness to travel for on-site training and field assessments as and when required

#### **What’s in it for you?**

* Join our purpose-driven organization. Help shape an industry in which two billion people rely on our products and services every day.
* Your development matters to us. We help you grow by offering the support you need to develop your skills and access a rewarding and fulfilling career.
* Thrive in a diverse and supportive culture. Through local and global initiatives, we promote a culture of inclusion which celebrates diversity and ensures that everyone feels valued.

#### **We Elevate… Your Career**

  

Become part of our team, help us enhance quality of life and drive innovation while raising the bar for safety and sustainability. We value your diverse skills and perspectives as together we shape the sustainable cities of today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Are you ready to embark on a new journey? Join #TeamSchindler! Discover more on our** **career website****.**

We endeavor that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, ethnic background, color, religious affiliation, union affiliation, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, nationality, genetics and health or disability.*

description:

Engineering helps empower and drive mission-critical solutions whether we need to modernize existing systems or implement new technology products and platforms. Through innovation, we improve financial performance, accelerate new digital businesses and fuel growth. Learn more about Engineering, AI and Data

  

**Your Work Profile**

  

We are seeking an experienced Storage Administrator – Senior Consultant to manage and optimize enterprise storage environments. This role focuses on block and file storage administration, SAN/NAS operations, replication, performance tuning, and high availability, ensuring storage platforms deliver reliability and efficiency for business-critical workloads. Key Responsibilities Storage Platform Administration

  

* Dell, IBM, NetApp C series/FAS, Brocade & HP SAN switches, File Storage

* Administer enterprise storage platforms including: o IBM Storage, Dell Storage, NetApp C-Series/FAS, HP SAN switches, and Brocade SAN switches.

* Perform storage provisioning, configuration, replication, snapshot management, and performance optimization.

* Manage both block (FC/iSCSI) and file (NFS/CIFS) storage environments.

* Monitor capacity, usage, and health of storage arrays; plan for growth and lifecycle upgrades. SAN & File Storage Operations

* Configure zoning, LUN mapping, multipathing, and access control for servers and users.

* Implement and manage replication strategies (synchronous/asynchronous) for critical workloads.

* Perform file system provisioning, quota management, and backup/restore operations.

* Monitor storage performance metrics and troubleshoot IOPS, throughput, and latency issues. High Availability & Disaster Recovery

* Participate in the implementation of HA and DR strategies for storage platforms.

* Support failover testing, disaster recovery exercises, and ensure recovery objectives are met.

* Collaborate with server, network, database, and application teams to maintain end-to-end availability. Automation, Monitoring & Reporting

* Automate storage administration tasks using scripting (PowerShell, Python, CLI tools) where applicable.

* Maintain monitoring dashboards and generate reports for capacity, performance, and SLA compliance.

* Proactively identify performance or capacity issues and recommend improvements. Documentation & Collaboration

* Maintain SOPs, configuration documentation, and architecture diagrams.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support storage integration with applications, virtualization, and cloud platforms.

• Support change management, incident resolution, and periodic storage audits. Required Skills • Hands-on expertise with IBM Storage, Dell Storage, NetApp C-Series/FAS.

  

**Key Skills Required**

  

* Education – Bachelor's or Master’s in Engineering.
* Strong experience with Brocade/HP SAN switches and storage networking (zoning, LUN masking, multipathing).
* Proficient in file storage provisioning, replication, snapshot management, access control, and performance tuning.
* Solid understanding of backup/recovery processes, HA solutions, and DR concepts.
* Experience with storage monitoring, capacity planning, and troubleshooting storage performance issues.
* Scripting/automation skills using PowerShell, Python, or CLI tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities; ability to handle escalated L2/L3 incidents. Experience
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise storage administration.
* Hands-on experience managing SAN/NAS storage systems in production environments.
* Exposure to ITIL-based processes such as Incident, Change, and Problem Management.
  

Good to Have

* Storage certifications (NetApp NCDA/NCIE, IBM Certified Specialist, Dell EMC Proven Professional).

* Familiarity with cloud storage solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) or software-defined storage (SDS).

* Knowledge of virtualization storage platforms like VMware vSAN or hyper-converged infrastructure (HCI).

title: Windows Server & Virtualization Administrator
description:
**Bangalore**
-------------

**Job Brief**
-------------

We are seeking a highly skilled Windows Server & Virtualization Administrator to manage, optimize, and secure the organization’s virtualization and Windows server infrastructure. The candidate should have hands-on experience with Microsoft Hyper-V, VMware vSphere, Windows Failover Clustering, and enterprise-class virtualization environments. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, security, and operational efficiency across virtualized platforms while supporting infrastructure growth, patch management, and compliance initiatives.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Design, implement, maintain, and upgrade Microsoft Hyper-V Failover Clusters, including Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV), quorum/witness configurations, virtual networking, and Hyper-V Replica.
* Administer and support VMware ESXi hosts and vCenter Server environments, including High Availability (HA) and Distributed Resource Scheduler (DRS) configurations.
* Manage Windows Failover Clustering across enterprise virtualization platforms to ensure optimal uptime and business continuity.
* Provision, configure, modify, migrate, and decommission virtual machines using vCenter, SCVMM, Hyper-V Manager, and Windows Admin Center.
* Monitor cluster health, virtualization performance, storage utilization, datastore capacity, and system alerts; perform regular cluster validation and health checks.
* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot storage connectivity technologies including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, SMB 3.0, MPIO, and HBA configurations in collaboration with storage teams.
* Monitor physical server health using vendor management tools such as iDRAC and iLO, coordinate hardware support activities, and manage vendor escalations.
* Implement and maintain virtualization and server security best practices, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Plan and execute server and virtualization platform patching, upgrades, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, system configurations, standard operating procedures, and disaster recovery processes.
* Participate in infrastructure capacity planning, performance tuning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide operational support and promptly resolve virtualization and server-related incidents and service requests.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 4-6 years of hands-on experience administering enterprise Windows Server and virtualization environments.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Failover Clustering, Cluster Shared Volumes (CSV), quorum configurations, and Hyper-V Replica.
* Experience administering VMware vSphere, including ESXi, vCenter Server, HA, and DRS.
* Proficiency with virtualization management tools such as SCVMM, Hyper-V Manager, Windows Admin Center, and vCenter.
* Solid understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, Fibre Channel, iSCSI, SMB 3.0, MPIO, and HBA management.
* Experience with backup and recovery solutions such as Veeam, Commvault, or equivalent enterprise backup platforms.
* Hands-on experience with physical server hardware, firmware management, and remote administration tools such as Dell iDRAC and HPE iLO.
* Knowledge of server hardening, virtualization security controls, vulnerability management, and patch management processes.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to service excellence.
* Flexibility to work in shifts and support multiple locations based on business requirements.

title: Exchange and Active Directory Administrator
description:
**Bangalore**
-------------

**Job Brief**
-------------

We are seeking an experienced Exchange and Active Directory Administrator to manage, secure, and optimize the organization’s messaging and identity infrastructure across Microsoft Exchange Server, Exchange Online, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID environments. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, security, and compliance of enterprise messaging and directory services, supporting hybrid identity solutions, mailbox migrations, disaster recovery, and automation initiatives.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
----------------------------

* Install, configure, administer, and upgrade Microsoft Exchange Server 2016/2019 and Exchange Server Subscription Edition (SE) environments.
* Design and maintain Database Availability Groups (DAGs), load balancing configurations, SSL certificates, and high-availability solutions for Exchange environments.
* Administer and support Exchange Online and hybrid Exchange deployments, including mailbox provisioning, migrations, coexistence, and hybrid connectivity.
* Manage mail flow components, including connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, message tracking, and troubleshooting email delivery issues.
* Implement and maintain email security controls, including Anti-Spam, Anti-Malware, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
* Administer and maintain Active Directory domains, forests, sites, trusts, domain controllers, FSMO roles, and replication services.
* Manage user accounts, groups, organizational units (OUs), service accounts, and delegated permissions throughout the account lifecycle.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs) to support organizational security and operational requirements.
* Administer and maintain AD-integrated DNS and DHCP services.
* Manage hybrid identity solutions using Microsoft Entra Connect and Cloud Sync, ensuring synchronization health and resolving identity-related issues.
* Perform Active Directory and Exchange backup, recovery, and disaster recovery testing, including authoritative restores and AD Recycle Bin recovery.
* Monitor Exchange and Active Directory performance, replication health, service availability, and capacity utilization.
* Plan and execute Exchange and Active Directory patching, cumulative updates, security updates, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Implement security best practices for messaging and identity platforms and ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts and administrative tools using PowerShell, including Exchange Management Shell and Active Directory modules.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), system architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Provide L2/L3 support for escalated incidents, changes, and problem management activities following ITIL-based processes.

**Requirements**
----------------

* + Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  + 4-6 years of hands-on experience administering enterprise Microsoft Exchange and Active Directory environments.
  + Strong experience with Exchange Server 2016/2019, Exchange Server SE, and Exchange Online administration.
  + Proven expertise in managing Database Availability Groups (DAGs), Exchange hybrid configurations, and mailbox migration projects.
  + Strong knowledge of email routing, mail flow management, connectors, transport rules, and messaging troubleshooting.
  + Experience implementing and managing email security solutions, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, and anti-spam/anti-malware technologies.
  + Deep understanding of Active Directory architecture, including domains, forests, trusts, replication, FSMO roles, and Group Policy.
  + Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Entra Connect, and hybrid identity synchronization.
  + Proficiency in administering DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server environments supporting Active Directory services.
  + Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills for Exchange and Active Directory administration.
  + Experience with backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning for messaging and identity platforms.
  + Knowledge of identity security, privileged access management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance best practices.
  + Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  + Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
  + Customer-focused mindset with strong organizational and documentation skills.
  + Flexible to work in shifts and provide support across multiple locations based on business requirements.
  + Relevant industry certifications are highly desirable, including:
  + - Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate
    - Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
    - Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
    - Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
    - ITIL Foundation Certification
  + Demonstrated commitment to continuous learning and professional development in messaging, identity, and cloud technologies.

title: Support Engineer
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Full-time

**About the job**
-----------------

**About Signeasy**

**Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.**

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

  

**Your role**

As our Support Engineer, you'll be part of the Customer Support team and the technical voice of Signeasy for our customers. You'll resolve the issues that need more than a help article: API errors, integration failures, SSO setups, mobile app, and tricky account problems. You'll handle tickets end to end and get on calls with our enterprise and API customers when a conversation works better than an email thread.

You'll be the bridge between customers and our engineering team. When something is broken, you'll reproduce it, find the root cause where you can, and hand engineering a clean, well-documented ticket. When something is confusing, you'll fix it at the source with better docs, macros, and product feedback.

If you enjoy digging into logs, love the moment a stubborn issue finally clicks, and care about leaving every customer better off than you found them, you'll find a lot to love here.

  

**What you'll do**

**Ticket resolution**

* Own tickets across email, chat, and phone, from first response to resolution, within our support SLAs
* Take escalations from the frontline team and resolve complex issues across our web app, iOS and Android apps, eSign API, and Intelligent Contract Management
* Troubleshoot integrations with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, Salesforce, and other tools our customers rely on
* Keep customers informed with clear, honest updates, and manage expectations on timelines and workarounds

**Enterprise and API customers**

* Join calls with enterprise and API customers to debug live issues, walk through setups, and answer technical questions
* Help developers integrate our eSign API: review their requests, read error responses, and point them to best practices
* Support admins with account configuration, SSO/SAML, user management, and compliance-related questions

**Debugging and escalation to engineering**

* Reproduce issues across platforms, and investigate using logs, HAR files, browser dev tools, API tools such as Postman, and SQL queries
* Separate configuration issues from real bugs, and file well-documented Jira tickets with steps to reproduce, impact, and customer context
* Follow escalations through to closure and close the loop with the customer

**Knowledge and product feedback**

* Write and update help center articles, internal runbooks, and Zendesk macros so the next customer or teammate solves it faster
* Spot recurring issues and trends, and share them with Product and Engineering to improve the product
* Respond to app store reviews that need a technical answer

**AI and automation**

* Use AI tools to investigate issues, draft responses, and summarize ticket trends
* Build simple scripts, automations, and templates that cut repetitive work for the support team
  

**Who you are**

We're looking for someone technical, curious, and customer-first: a problem solver who takes ownership and doesn't let an issue go cold.

* 3 to 4 years of experience in technical or product support for a B2B SaaS product
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, and JSON, with hands-on experience using Postman or similar tools
* Comfort reading logs, analyzing HAR files, and using browser developer tools
* Experience troubleshooting web and mobile apps
* Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar helpdesk) and Jira
* Confidence leading customer calls, including with technical and enterprise stakeholders
* Strong written and spoken English, with a clear, empathetic, and crisp communication style
* Self-driven, organized, and calm under pressure, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities
  

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with SSO/SAML, OAuth, and webhooks
* Exposure to integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365
* Basic scripting in Python or JavaScript
* Experience with iOS or Android debugging tools
  

**Why you'll love this role**

This role sits at the center of everything we ship. You'll work with customers of every size, from individual professionals to enterprise and API teams, and partner closely with Product and Engineering to make Signeasy better every week.

Your work will directly shape how customers experience Signeasy: how quickly their problems are solved, how much they trust us, and how the product improves based on what they tell us.

It's a high-ownership role with clear room to grow, into senior support, support operations, solutions engineering, or product, depending on where your interests take you.

  

**Why work with Signeasy**

Our values make us a TIGER: Trust, Integrity, Growth mindset, Empathy, and Responsibility.

We're a lean, close-knit, and nimble team. We're opinionated but collaborative: we disagree, then commit to a shared decision. We're modern, but we don't follow trends blindly. We're easy to work with, and we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask lots of questions, experiment, and learn fast. And we're deeply empathetic toward our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Our people are our greatest asset. You'll work alongside some of the smartest, most humble people around the world, who come from diverse backgrounds and bring a wide range of experiences. We're a hybrid-friendly organization that values flexibility, with a mix of in-person collaboration at the office and focused work from home.

We are the #SigneasyTribe. Ask us plenty of questions about our culture, so we can both see whether there's a real connection that makes this a great experience for both of us.

  

**We'd love to hear from you**

Great talent comes from all kinds of paths. If this role speaks to you, please apply, even if you don't match every line on paper. We review every application and will get back to you within a week.

* Hear what it's like to work at Signeasy
* Meet Signeasy's leadership team
* Read our origin story
* Take a peek at Signeasy's culture
* Learn more about growth at Signeasy

Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

* Communicating with end users on support issues and managing the support process with Maconomy Support
* Review and recommend changes to the Maconomy systems ERP portfolio.
* Assist with the migration/setup of new companies (following acquisitions being migrated onto Maconomy to align processes and support efficiencies around consolidation / reporting / workflows) as well as projects within Maconomy, including security administration, maintaining users, groups, and user roles.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About Us**

Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.

  

Today, 20 million+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. We are one of the leaders in UPI autopay transactions, crossing more than 1 million transactions per day. In 2023, we expanded our vision with Nek, our jewelry brand crafted to bring together luxury and affordability, it has since surpassed ₹100 crore in revenue.

  

We have a big dream of bringing “Har Ghar Sona”. Small, consistent savings are just the start. We’re here to walk alongside our users, helping Indians secure their financial future every step of the way.

  

Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.

And this is just the beginning!

  

**What’s the role?**  
  
  
  
As a Senior Product Analyst at Jar, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our product and user experience through data. This is not just a number-crunching role - you’ll be a strategic partner to product, growth, and leadership teams, driving decisions that directly impact millions of users. You will lead deep product analysis, define success metrics, run high-velocity experiments, and build scalable data systems that empower teams across the company. If you're passionate about connecting insights to action, simplifying complexity, and driving meaningful business outcomes, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact at a profitable, high-growth startup.  
  
  
  
**What will be your responsibilities?**

* *Turn data into insight:* Dive deep into product usage data to uncover trends, identify friction points, and surface actionable insights. Projects could include: funnel conversion, retention analysis, pricing experiments, feature adoption deep-dives, and cohort behavior.
* *Partner with Product & Growth teams:* Work closely with PMs, engineers, and designers to define metrics, run experiments, and inform product decisions with robust data.
* *Build scalable reporting:* Own the creation of dashboards and self-serve datasets in tools like Looker Studio to democratize access to insights across teams.
* *Define success metrics:* Help teams measure what matters by building metric frameworks to track the impact of product initiatives and experiments.
* *Drive experimentation rigor:* Support A/B test design, statistical validation, and post-analysis, helping drive a test-and-learn culture.
* *Tell compelling data stories:* Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders using crisp storytelling and visuals.
* *Maintain data hygiene & quality:* Collaborate with data engineers and product teams to ensure tracking accuracy and consistency across platform.

  

**What’s required from you?**

* 2-5 years of experience as a product analyst or data analyst, ideally in a B2C or fintech environment
* Proficiency in Mixpanel is a must; hands-on experience with event-based tracking systems (eg: Mixpanel, Amplitude) is preferred
* Strong understanding of product analytics: Activation, retention, funnels, segmentation, and LTV/CAC modeling.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding
* Experience working with mobile-first user journeys and behavioral data
* Bonus: Experience with Python or R or SQL for advanced analysis or automation
* Bonus: Familiarity with dbt or Airflow for data transformation and modeling

  

**You’ll Thrive at Jar If You Are**

  

* *User-first & Product-savvy:* You care deeply about user behavior and can connect data to real-world product impact
* *Curious & Proactive:* You don’t wait for instructions—you explore data, uncover patterns, and bring hypotheses to the table
* *Clear Communicator:* You can simplify complex data for decision-makers and speak the language of both engineers and business
* *Collaborative:* You’re a team player who can work cross-functionally with growth, product, and tech teams
* *Outcome-oriented:* You focus on business impact, not just reporting numbers

  

**What makes us different?**

  

We’re not just building a product—we’re shaping the future of savings in India. We seek people who bring passion, energy, and fresh ideas to help us make that happen. Experience matters, but we are a potential first organisation. We move fast, learn from our mistakes, and take bold risks to solve problems that haven’t been attempted before. If you’re excited about working in an environment where people inspire and truly support each other, you’ve found the right fit.

  

**What do we stand for?**

  

The five values that we live by :

  

**Passion:** At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work.
  
**Equality:** We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves.
  
**Growth:** When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact.
  
**Accountability:** The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions.
  
**Consistency:** We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time.

  

Join us and let’s build something amazing together!

**What employee benefits do we have?**

  

Glad you asked! Among other things, we have

  

* Medical Insurance for employees and their families
* Employee Wellbeing Program
* ESOPs allocation
* Pluxee meal card
* Swish club card for exclusive employee discounts
* Advance salary plans
* Relocation assistance
* L&D programmes

Global SCM Manager

This position reports to the Global SCM Manager, Motion Drive Products.

* Negotiate agreements with main suppliers, and periodically renew price lists, and terms and conditions.
* Ensure identification, investigation and selection of appropriate suppliers (focusing on quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability) in accordance with company policies, drives the collaboration with Supplier relationship management (SRM) as Supplier account Manager (SAM) for selected global EMS partners
* Define and establish local and global standard agreements with all major suppliers.
* Plan and support the implementation of cost-out programs and/or processes to reach financial targets.
* Contribute to and participate in setting and implementing budgets and targets within the group of global categories, and ensures the EMS category sourcing performance targets are achieved.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Engineering or in a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in procurement or supply chain management with strong understanding of EMS manufacturing processes.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and networking skills. Fluency in English, with other languages being a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent business acumen and build effective Supplier Relationship Management
* Strong technical, commercial, and interpersonal skills. Ability to develop and execute long-term strategies.
* Previous experience in Budget & Performance Management.
* Willingness to travel.

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward. Contribute to a collective vision. This is where progress takes flight, teams turn ideas into impact, and we define what’s next. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – ADMISSION OFFICER

**Department:** Admissions  
**Designation:** Admission Officer  
**Location:** Winmore Academy – Jakkur , Bengaluru  
**Reports To:** Admission Manager / Principal  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The Admission Officer is responsible for managing the end-to-end student admission process, from handling enquiries and counselling parents to completing admission formalities and maintaining accurate student records. The role requires excellent communication, interpersonal, organisational, and follow-up skills to ensure a smooth admission experience for parents and students.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Admission Enquiries and Parent Counselling**

* Handle walk-in, telephone, email, website, and other admission enquiries.
* Provide accurate information about the school’s curriculum, facilities, fee structure, academic programmes, and admission procedures.
* Counsel parents and prospective students regarding suitable classes and admission requirements.
* Conduct school tours and explain the school’s facilities, academic approach, and extracurricular activities.

**B. Admission Process Management**

* Manage the complete admission process from initial enquiry to final enrolment.
* Collect, verify, and maintain admission forms and supporting documents.
* Coordinate entrance assessments, student interactions, and meetings with the Principal or academic team, wherever applicable.
* Ensure timely completion of admission formalities and adherence to school policies.
* Coordinate with the Accounts Department for fee payment confirmation and admission-related transactions.

**C. Lead Management and Follow-Up**

* Maintain an updated database of prospective parents and admission enquiries.
* Follow up with interested parents through calls, messages, and emails.
* Track enquiry conversion rates, admission status, pending documents, and parent responses.
* Work towards achieving the admission and enrolment targets assigned by the management.

**D. Documentation and MIS Reporting**

* Maintain accurate admission registers, student records, enquiry trackers, and digital databases.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports on enquiries, school visits, conversions, admissions, and pending cases.
* Ensure the confidentiality and accuracy of student and parent information.
* Maintain all admission documents in accordance with school procedures.

**E. Coordination and Customer Service**

* Coordinate with the Principal, teachers, administration, accounts, and transport departments to facilitate admissions.
* Respond professionally to parent queries and resolve admission-related concerns.
* Ensure a positive and welcoming experience for prospective families.
* Participate in admission campaigns, open houses, school events, and promotional activities as required.

3. Educational Qualification

* Graduate in any discipline.
* A degree or diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field will be an added advantage.

4. Experience

* 2–4 years of experience in school admissions, education counselling, customer relations, or sales.
* Experience in a CBSE school or a reputed educational institution is preferred.
* Freshers with excellent communication and interpersonal skills may also be considered.

5. Required Skills and Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Proficiency in Kannada and Hindi will be an added advantage.
* Strong parent counselling, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Good follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, email, and admission management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries and meet admission targets.
* Professional conduct, patience, attention to detail, and a parent-centric approach.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of admission enquiries handled.
* Enquiry-to-school-visit conversion rate.
* School-visit-to-admission conversion rate.
* Achievement of monthly and annual admission targets.
* Timely follow-up with prospective parents.
* Accuracy and completeness of admission documentation.
* Parent satisfaction and quality of admission counselling.
* Timeliness and accuracy of admission MIS reports.

7. Working Conditions

* Full-time position based at the assigned school campus.
* Willingness to work during admission drives, open houses, and school events, as required.
* Adherence to school policies, professional standards, and confidentiality requirements.

**Note:** The Admission Officer is expected to represent the school professionally and contribute to student enrolment growth through effective counselling, systematic follow-up, and excellent parent relationship management.

title: Barista/All Rounder
description:
Okay so, hi.

If you’re the kind of person who has a strong opinion about which café makes the best matcha in Bangalore, who saves reels of latte art and weird flavour combos, who has three hobbies at any given time and goes all in on each one, I think we’d get along.

Ouna Matcha is our little matcha bar on 11th Main, Indiranagar. Nine seats, iced matcha only, and a menu we keep messing around with because we can’t help ourselves. We make everything ourselves, the strawberry milk, the syrups, the dips, all of it, in small batches.

We’re looking for someone to stand behind the bar with us. Not just someone who can follow a recipe, but someone who actually cares how the drink turns out and gets excited when a customer comes back for the same one.

**You’ll probably love this if**

* You like making things and you like making them well
* You’re curious. About matcha, about food, about music, about whatever you’re into right now
* You enjoy people. Chatting with whoever walks in, remembering the regular who always wants extra strawberry
* You can laugh through a crazy rush and a mountain of dishes after
* You have ideas and you’re not shy about sharing them

Café experience is great, but if you haven’t done this before and you really want to, that’s fine. We’ll teach you everything about matcha, how we whisk, how our matchas differ, and every drink on the menu.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Making matcha, the fun part
* Helping people find their new favourite
* Prepping our milks, syrups and dips
* Opening and closing the café
* Keeping an eye on stock
* Cleaning. A lot. It’s part of the job and we all do it.

**We’re in this together**

We’re a small team and there’s no “that’s not my job” here. Whoever’s free takes the next order. Whoever’s closest grabs the dishes. If the bar’s slammed, we all jump on it, and if someone’s having a rough day, the rest of us pick up the slack. The founders are behind the bar too, whisking, prepping and mopping right alongside you. We figure things out together, we celebrate the good days together, and we get through the chaotic ones together.

**The details**

* **Café hours:** 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
* **Your shift:** 10:30 AM till the closing prepis done. Usually around 8:30 PM.
* **Weekly off:** Monday
* **Pay:** ₹10,000 – ₹27,000 per month
* **Location:** In person, Indiranagar, Bengaluru

If this felt like it was written for you, it probably was. Apply here and let's get you on the team!

You will lead discovery and requirements workshops, challenge solution-led requests, shape service and functional designs, complete authorised configuration, coordinate testing and releases, investigate incidents and defects and deliver service improvements. You will also help design joined-up People services and lifecycle journeys involving other functions, while those functions remain responsible for their own services and activities.

You will maintain the configuration, design, testing, release and operational documentation required for governance, auditability, service continuity and future change. Through direct delivery, partner challenge, knowledge transfer and continuous learning, you will strengthen internal capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners.

Although primarily aligned to People Service & Experience, you may support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.

Key responsibilities

* Work with global, regional and functional stakeholders to understand service challenges, business problems, user needs and desired outcomes, ensuring discussions remain focused on the need rather than a predetermined technology solution.

* Lead discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, translating business and service requirements into clear options, service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs and acceptance criteria.

* Act as a senior subject-matter specialist for ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, bringing strong platform knowledge, leading practices and service insight into business and delivery decisions.

* Deliver authorised ServiceNow configuration, administration, enhancements, workflow improvements and optimisation within agreed access, security, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.

* Take ownership of assigned changes from discovery through design, configuration, testing, release, operational handover and early-life support, maintaining appropriate traceability, documentation and evidence throughout the lifecycle.

* Analyse People services, processes, user journeys, case-management requirements, service-catalogue structures, knowledge needs, workflows, roles, permissions and integrations to shape effective end-to-end solutions.

* Support the development of consistent global People services and ways of working, simplifying, standardising and automating processes while recognising legitimate regional and regulatory requirements.

* Configure and improve Employee Centre and digital service experiences, service-catalogue, case-management, knowledge, employee and manager self-service and workflow capabilities, including forms, record producers, routing, assignment, approvals, notifications, service levels and supporting metadata.

* Design and configure HRSD lifecycle events, coordinating with other functions where journeys include activities such as IT provisioning, identity and access, equipment, Security, Facilities, Learning or background screening, while those functions remain accountable for their own services.
* + Apply service-design, journey-mapping and experience-design practices to simplify employee and manager interactions and improve end-to-end service outcomes.

  + Assess incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, investigating root causes and recommending appropriate resolutions or improvements.

  + Coordinate functional, regression and user-acceptance testing and support product and vendor-release cycles, including impact assessment, business readiness, deployment, operational handover and post-release review.

  + Create and maintain configuration workbooks, requirements, service and functional designs, workflow and service-catalogue records, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge, ensuring documentation remains aligned to the live platform and supports auditability, continuity and future change.

  + Monitor product health, service and workflow performance, adoption and usability, identifying opportunities to improve configuration, simplify services, increase automation and deliver greater business value.

  + Work confidently with support and implementation partners, reviewing and constructively challenging designs, configuration, testing, documentation and delivery outputs, while ensuring effective knowledge transfer and reducing unnecessary partner dependency.

  + Maintain and develop relevant ServiceNow expertise through product learning, release awareness, practical delivery and appropriate certification, sharing knowledge to improve resilience across the team.

  + Contribute to the Service & Experience People Technology Community, working with regional stakeholders, super users and champions to gather insight, strengthen adoption and improve effective use of the portfolio.

  + Support the future development of colleague-listening and experience-management capabilities, including Qualtrics, translating feedback and journey insight into actionable service and product improvements.

  + Partner with the Foundation team and architecture, security, data, integration and Microsoft product teams to support effective integration between ServiceNow, SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products and other enterprise technologies.

  + Support other People Technology domains where demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require, while maintaining accountability for assigned Service & Experience responsibilities.

  **Candidate Specification :**

  **Essential**

  + Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery, including practical configuration, functional or service design, testing and controlled platform-change delivery.

  + Strong understanding of HR service delivery, case management, service catalogues, knowledge management, employee and manager self-service, workflow automation, lifecycle events and related People services.

  + Experience leading discovery, requirements and solution-shaping workshops, keeping stakeholders focused on business problems, service needs and desired outcomes rather than predetermined technology solutions.

  + Ability to translate business and service requirements into clear service designs, functional requirements, workflow designs, configuration decisions and acceptance criteria.

  + Experience taking ownership of ServiceNow changes from analysis and design through configuration, testing, release, operational handover and post-implementation review.

  + Experience configuring and improving HRSD capabilities such as case management, record producers, service catalogues, forms, routing, assignment rules, workflows, notifications, approvals, knowledge and lifecycle events.

  + Experience assessing incidents, defects, service issues, enhancements and optimisation opportunities, including impact analysis, root-cause investigation and recommendations, together with experience coordinating product and vendor-release cycles.

  + Experience producing and maintaining configuration workbooks, functional and service designs, workflow documentation, service-catalogue records, test evidence, release artefacts, operating procedures and product knowledge.

  + Confidence working with business stakeholders, Product Managers, Project Managers, technical specialists and third-party partners, including constructively challenging proposed designs, configuration, testing outputs and documentation.

  + Ability to deliver authorised configuration and improvements while observing security, access, data-protection, change-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.

  + Commitment to maintaining deep ServiceNow expertise through practical delivery, release awareness, relevant learning or certification and active knowledge sharing.

  + Ability to contribute across adjacent People Technology capabilities when demand, resilience, holiday cover or development priorities require.

  **Desirable**

  + Experience configuring ServiceNow lifecycle events or orchestrating employee journeys involving People, IT, Security, Facilities, Learning, identity and access, equipment or background-screening activities.

  + Experience designing or improving global service catalogues, service taxonomies, case-management models or knowledge-management frameworks.

  + Experience applying service design, experience design, journey mapping, user-experience or human-centred-design practices to improve employee and manager services.

  + Experience with Qualtrics or comparable colleague-listening, survey or experience-management platforms.

  + Experience integrating ServiceNow with SAP SuccessFactors, OpenText, Microsoft products or other enterprise platforms.

  + Experience delivering change through internal teams, blended delivery teams and partner-led arrangements.

  + Experience supporting global People services while balancing global standards with regional, regulatory and operational requirements.

  + Experience working with super users, champion networks, communities of practice or a People Technology Community to support feedback, knowledge sharing and adoption.

  + Experience using agile, iterative or structured change and release-management practices.

  + Experience contributing across multiple People Technology products, platforms or functional domains.

  **Qualifications & Certifications: Desirable**

  Product and Platform

  + ServiceNow Certified System Administrator

  + ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist: Human Resources

  + Other relevant ServiceNow implementation, application-development or workflow certification

  + Qualtrics or comparable experience-management certification

  + ITIL Foundation or higher certification

  + Service-design qualification

  + Journey-mapping, user-experience or human-centred-design qualification

  + Knowledge-management qualification

At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

description:
Overview:

**Manager, Atlassian Products**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Director, Business Technology

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

People Manager – Mid/Senior

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian tools – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – sit at the center of how work gets planned, tracked, and documented across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Manager, Atlassian Products is a player-manager responsible for leading HealthEdge's Atlassian platform team while remaining technically engaged in the work. You will manage a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators – supporting thousands of users across engineering, IT, product, and business functions. Reporting to the Director, Business Technology, you are accountable for platform health, governance, stakeholder relationships, and team development.

This is a growth environment. The Atlassian team today spans approximately 14 people and is expected to grow toward 24 as HealthEdge's platform needs expand. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and developing talent for a 6-8 person group while ensuring the platform continues to meet the demands of a complex, fast-moving organization.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Team Leadership & Development**
---------------------------------

* Lead, manage, and develop a globally distributed team of Atlassian Administrators in India
* Drive hiring for open roles on the Atlassian Products team, partnering with HR and the Director, Business Technology to scale the team toward its target size
* Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, conduct performance reviews, and support career development for all direct reports
* Build a high-performing team culture grounded in platform rigor, user focus, and continuous improvement
* Manage team capacity, workload distribution, and prioritization across the support queue and project backlog

**Platform Strategy & Governance**
----------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform roadmap in partnership with the Director, Business Technology – defining priorities, driving improvements, and aligning with organizational needs
* Establish and enforce governance standards for project structure, permissions, naming conventions, workflows, and Confluence space management across the organization
* Lead the evaluation and lifecycle management of Atlassian Marketplace apps — assessing fit, managing licenses, and governing usage
* Oversee Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, security policies, and license management
* Drive platform hygiene initiatives and ensure the environment remains clean, well-documented, and audit-ready

**Technical Oversight & Solution Design**
-----------------------------------------

* Serve as the escalation point for complex platform issues and solution design decisions that exceed senior administrator scope
* Guide the design and implementation of advanced Jira, JSM, and Confluence configurations including complex workflows, automation frameworks, and cross-project solutions
* Oversee the development and maintenance of scripts and automation rules across the platform
* Ensure platform changes follow change management practices with appropriate testing, documentation, and rollback planning
* Stay current on Atlassian product developments, roadmap changes, and best practices, and translate these into team guidance

**Stakeholder Management**
--------------------------

* Serve as the primary business relationship owner for Atlassian products across IT, Engineering, Product, and business functions
* Partner with senior stakeholders to understand evolving platform needs and translate them into prioritized, scalable solutions
* Run regular stakeholder touchpoints, communicate platform changes and improvements proactively, and manage escalations professionally
* Partner with the ITSM team to ensure JSM is optimized for IT service delivery – SLAs, queues, automations, and reporting

**Operations & Reporting**
--------------------------

* Own the Atlassian support queue at a team level – ensuring SLA compliance, queue health, and consistent quality of delivery
* Produce and present regular reporting on platform health, team performance, license utilization, and open initiatives
* Manage the Atlassian vendor relationship including renewal negotiations, support cases, and TAM engagement
* Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access, configuration, and data governance

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 5+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, with deep expertise in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* 2+ years of people management experience, including hiring, developing, and performance-managing technical team members
* Proven ability to lead a team in a global, distributed environment
* Strong platform governance experience – designing and enforcing standards across a large, complex Atlassian environment
* Experience with Atlassian Cloud administration including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and security policy management
* Hands-on experience with Jira automation (native) and advanced automation tooling
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business requirements into platform solutions
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or equivalent) strongly preferred
* Experience managing Atlassian teams or platforms through growth, migrations, or consolidation projects
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and applying them within JSM for enterprise ITSM
* Experience with Atlassian Marketplace apps at scale (ScriptRunner, Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, Elements Connect, or similar)
* Exposure to REST API integrations with Atlassian platforms
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT integration or multi-instance Atlassian environments

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have a clear picture of the current team, platform state, and stakeholder landscape, have identified the highest-priority gaps in governance and delivery, and have begun filling open roles. Within six months, the team is operating with clear standards, the support queue is consistently within SLA, and key stakeholders have a trusted partner in you. Within a year, the Atlassian Products team has grown toward its target size, platform governance is mature and well-documented, and you have established the function as a reliable, high-performing part of the Business Technology organization.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll lead a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates. With Jira Software driving engineering and product delivery, JSM powering IT service management, and Confluence serving as the organization's knowledge backbone, the platform this team manages touches every function in the company. It's a high-visibility role with real impact — and a team and roadmap that reflect a serious, long-term investment in the Atlassian platform.

**Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent**

* **The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.**

description:
Overview:

**Atlassian Architect**

Job Description

**Department:**

Business Technology – Atlassian Products

**Reports To:**

Manager, Atlassian Products

**Location:**

India – Bangalore (On-site)

**Level:**

Individual Contributor – Senior/Principal

**About HealthEdge**
====================

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale. Atlassian – Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence – is the connective tissue of how work gets planned, tracked, and executed across the entire organization.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Atlassian Architect is the highest-level individual contributor on the Atlassian Products team, responsible for defining platform architecture, setting technical standards, and solving the most complex problems in HealthEdge's Atlassian environment. This is not an administration role – it is a design and engineering role. You will own the decisions that shape how the platform is built, governed, and extended, and your work will directly influence how thousands of employees across the company plan, collaborate, and deliver. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, the Architect will also shape the platform's AI readiness — ensuring the architecture supports Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo at enterprise scale.

You will serve as the technical authority for the Atlassian Products team – providing architectural guidance, mentoring Senior and regular Administrators, leading complex solution delivery, and acting as the primary point of escalation for problems that require deep platform expertise. You will also own strategic initiatives including instance governance, automation frameworks, API integrations, and migration or consolidation efforts.

**What You'll Do**
==================

**Platform Architecture & Standards**
-------------------------------------

* Own the Atlassian platform architecture across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Atlassian Access – defining how these tools are structured, governed, and extended at scale
* Establish and maintain technical standards for project design, workflow architecture, permission models, field configuration, and Confluence space taxonomy across the organization
* Design scalable, maintainable solutions that balance user needs with platform health – avoiding configuration sprawl and technical debt
* Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities, product roadmap changes, and Marketplace apps – assessing fit, risk, and adoption strategy
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation including design decisions, standards references, and solution blueprints

**Complex Solution Design & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

* Lead discovery and solution design for the most complex stakeholder requests – those that require cross-project thinking, advanced automation, or architectural changes
* Translate ambiguous business requirements from engineering, IT, product, and business functions into well-structured, scalable Atlassian solutions
* Deliver end-to-end implementation of high-complexity configurations, including multi-project workflow frameworks, advanced JSM service architectures, and cross-tool integrations
* Partner with the Manager, Atlassian Products to define and manage the platform improvement roadmap, sequencing initiatives by impact and feasibility

**Automation & Scripting**
--------------------------

* Design and implement advanced automation frameworks using native Jira/JSM automation and ScriptRunner (Groovy) for complex workflow logic, validators, post-functions, and listeners
* Build and maintain REST API integrations between Atlassian tools and external systems including identity platforms, ITSM tools, and business applications
* Establish automation standards and reusable patterns that the broader admin team can follow and extend
* Review and quality-assure automation and scripting work produced by Senior Administrators, providing technical guidance and improvement feedback

**Migrations & Consolidations**
-------------------------------

* Lead or architect Atlassian migration and consolidation projects, including instance-to-instance migrations, Server/Data Center to Cloud transitions, and post-merger platform integrations
* Perform pre-migration assessments including configuration audits, data mapping, and risk analysis
* Design migration runbooks and execute or oversee technical migration steps with appropriate rollback planning
* Ensure data integrity, permission continuity, and minimal disruption to end users throughout migration events

**Enterprise Governance & Security**
------------------------------------

* Own Atlassian Access configuration including SSO, SCIM provisioning, authentication policies, IP allowlisting, and audit log management
* Design and enforce the organization-wide governance model for Atlassian – covering project creation standards, permission scheme governance, license management, and app approval processes
* Lead license optimization efforts, identifying consolidation opportunities and ensuring spend is aligned with actual usage
* Support security and compliance requirements including access reviews, data residency considerations, and audit evidence related to Atlassian platforms
* Serve as the technical lead for any Atlassian-related security incidents, misconfigurations, or compliance findings

**Team Mentorship & Technical Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Serve as the informal technical lead for the Atlassian Products team – the person Senior and regular Administrators bring their hardest problems to
* Mentor Senior Administrators on advanced configuration, automation, and solution design, actively developing their technical depth
* Conduct technical design reviews for significant platform changes proposed by team members
* Contribute to hiring by participating in technical assessments for Atlassian Administrator and Senior Administrator candidates
* Represent the Atlassian Products team in cross-functional technical forums and architecture discussions

**What You'll Bring**
=====================

**Required**
------------

* 7+ years of deep, hands-on Atlassian platform experience with expert-level proficiency in Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Atlassian architectures for large, complex organizations (thousands of users, dozens of teams)
* Expert-level proficiency in ScriptRunner (Groovy) scripting for advanced workflow customization, automation, and platform extensions
* Strong REST API experience with Atlassian platforms — building integrations, automating administrative tasks, and extending platform capabilities
* Proven experience leading Atlassian migrations or consolidation projects, including Cloud migrations
* Deep understanding of Atlassian Cloud security and governance including Atlassian Access, SSO/SCIM, and enterprise-scale permission management
* Ability to communicate architectural decisions clearly to both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

**Preferred**
-------------

* Atlassian certifications strongly preferred – ACP-120, ACP-420, ACP-620, or Atlassian Certified Expert (ACE) designation
* Familiarity with how Atlassian platform architecture affects AI indexing quality and Rovo answer relevance
* Experience with advanced Marketplace apps at architectural scale (Insight/Assets, Advanced Roadmaps, ScriptRunner, Elements Connect, Tempo)
* Exposure to enterprise ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and applying them within JSM at an architectural level
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and DevOps tooling that integrates with Atlassian (AWS, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines)
* Experience in a healthcare, SaaS, or other regulated industry environment
* Background in post-merger IT platform integration or multi-instance Atlassian consolidation

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within 90 days, you have completed a thorough assessment of the current Atlassian environment, identified the top architectural gaps and technical debt priorities, and established yourself as the go-to technical authority on the team. Within six months, you have delivered at least one significant platform improvement, established or formalized key governance standards, and are actively mentoring the admin team. Within a year, the Atlassian platform at HealthEdge reflects clear architectural ownership — well-governed, well-documented, and built to scale — and you have meaningfully elevated the technical capability of everyone around you.

**About the Team**
==================

You'll join a dedicated Atlassian Products team that is central to how HealthEdge operates at scale. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who wants to be the definitive technical expert on a platform that touches every part of the business. You'll have the backing of an engaged manager, a growing team of administrators to mentor, and a real mandate to shape how the platform evolves. If you want to do the most technically interesting Atlassian work of your career, this is that role.

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **Copywriter** who can develop compelling, engaging, and impactful content across digital and offline platforms. The ideal candidate should have strong writing skills, a good understanding of brand communication, and the ability to create persuasive copy that connects with the target audience.

The candidate should be comfortable writing short-form content, social media captions, ad copies, campaign concepts, website content, and marketing communications while maintaining the brand’s tone of voice.

* Develop creative and engaging copy for social media platforms, digital campaigns, advertisements, websites, and marketing collaterals.
* Create compelling short-form content, including captions, headlines, taglines, hooks, and promotional messages.
* Write persuasive ad copies for paid marketing campaigns across Meta, Google, and other digital platforms.
* Collaborate with social media managers, graphic designers, performance marketers, and creative teams to develop integrated campaigns.
* Develop campaign concepts, creative ideas, and brand messaging aligned with business objectives.
* Write long-form content when required, including blogs, articles, landing pages, email campaigns, and website content.
* Understand the target audience and create content that drives engagement, brand awareness, and conversions.
* Research industry trends, competitors, and audience preferences to develop relevant and impactful content.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure grammatical accuracy, clarity, consistency, and adherence to brand guidelines.
* Adapt writing styles and tones according to different brands, platforms, and target audiences.
* Work on multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining content quality.
* Incorporate feedback from internal teams and stakeholders to refine creative output.

* 3–5 years of experience in copywriting, content writing, advertising, or a related creative role.
* Excellent command of written English, grammar, vocabulary, and storytelling.
* Strong expertise in short-form copywriting, including social media captions, ad copies, headlines, and campaign messaging.
* Ability to develop creative concepts and translate ideas into engaging content.
* Understanding of social media platforms, digital marketing, and audience engagement.
* Ability to write persuasive, brand-focused, and conversion-oriented content.
* Strong research, editing, proofreading, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with creative and marketing teams.

* Experience working with advertising agencies, digital marketing agencies, or in-house marketing teams.
* Experience in real estate, lifestyle, hospitality, or consumer-facing brands is an added advantage.
* Familiarity with SEO principles and content optimisation.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted writing tools and content research platforms.
* Understanding of current social media trends, internet culture, and emerging content formats.

Key Competencies

* Creativity and original thinking
* Strong storytelling and communication
* Attention to detail
* Brand voice development
* Adaptability and problem-solving
* Ability to work under tight deadlines
* Openness to feedback and continue.
